question.text: Find the values of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi></math>  in the given balanced equation  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mo>→</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo> </mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo> </mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> ,

solution.text:
Sulphur gains 8 electron in reduction and iodide ion loses 1 electron in oxidation.

Thus values of x, y, z are 8, 4, 4 respectively hence the reaction is

H2SO4+8HI→H2S+4I2+4H2O
